messages.content: In this fictional trial, a missing sensor reading could be handled by the timer fallback instead of an undefined response.
That preserves the reason for predictability while allowing valid readings to adjust watering. An adaptive forecast schedule could be explored separately.

Adopt sensor control with the fixed-timer fallback. It addresses rain and missing readings while preserving predictable fault behavior. Supersede timer-only operation, keep sensor-only rejected, and leave adaptive forecast scheduling deferred.
